plugins.name: AniList Sync
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Marks the anime episodes you watch as watched on your AniList.
uses: What your video plugins report as playing
Your AniList account, after you sign in with your own AniList app

plugins.name: MyAnimeList Sync
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Marks the anime episodes you watch as watched on your MyAnimeList.
uses: What your video plugins report as playing
Your MyAnimeList account, after you sign in with your own MyAnimeList client
Port 47301 on this PC, only while you sign in

plugins.name: Netflix
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Shows what you watch on Netflix in your browser on your profile.
uses: The Netflix tab in your browser, for the title, episode and playback
Cinemeta online, for IMDb links your trackers use

plugins.name: Roblox
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Shows the Roblox game you play on your profile, with your avatar. Nothing to set up.
uses: Whether Roblox is running, and its log file, for the game you are in and your user ID
Details games write to that log for Bloxstrap's rich presence (BloxstrapRPC)
Roblox's public game, avatar and image pages online, for names and pictures

plugins.name: Simkl Sync
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Marks the movies, episodes and anime you watch as watched on your Simkl.
uses: What your video plugins report as playing
Your Simkl account, after you sign in with your own Simkl app

plugins.name: Stremio
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Shows what you watch in Stremio on your profile. Nothing to set up.
uses: Windows media controls, for what is playing
Stremio’s player and saved library, for titles and episodes
AniList and Cinemeta online, for posters and links

plugins.name: Valorant
plugins.author: Aura
plugins.description: Shows your VALORANT mode, map, agent, score and party on your profile. Nothing to set up.
uses: The Riot Client's local connection on your PC (its lockfile), for your game state, party and rank
VALORANT's log file, for the agent you pick and when the match started
valorant-api.com, for map, agent and rank names and pictures
